criteria.description: Changing any filter resets page to 1: App.tsx uses a wrapper handler that calls both setFilters(next) and setPage(1).
criteria.evidence: Code inspection of App.tsx: line 14-19 defines handleFilterChange = useCallback that calls setFilters(next) and setPage(1). Line 39: FilterPanel receives onChange={handleFilterChange}. Line 42: SortSelect receives onChange={(sortBy) => handleFilterChange({ ...filters, sortBy })}. Raw setFilters is never passed directly to either component.
